title: C API: PyConfig_Set() should update global variables (such as Py_InspectFlag)
author: vstinner
body_preview: `PyConfig_Set()` sets `PyInterpreterState.config` and `sys` attributes (such as `sys.flags`), but it doesn't set global variables (such as `Py_InspectFlag`).
